architecture.authority: Committed ADR-014 and Day 3 freeze/implementation plan
clarifications: Effect identity is generated once by admission, not pure compilation; persisted replay/reopen proves stability.
All Action HTTP routes, including reads, await Prompt 3 verified capability/visibility.
Six-state graph/CAS/schema contracts are foundations; only Pending creation is implemented.

approval_binding.encoding: UTF-8; sorted keys; compact separators; ensure_ascii=false; allow_nan=false; no BOM/newline/normalization/coercion
approval_binding.storage: approval_plan_bindings; one immutable companion per decision; exactly five ADR-014 fields
approval_binding.atomicity: PASS: Run CAS, decision, binding and original audit event commit together
approval_binding.duplicate_decision: PASS: unchanged conflicts; no rebind/version/event churn
approval_binding.concurrency: PASS: APPROVE/APPROVE, REJECT/REJECT, APPROVE/REJECT; one winner
approval_binding.uncertain_commit: PASS: safe error, explicit read discovers committed decision; no guessed success
approval_binding.threat_limit: Integrity evidence, not a signature/MAC, authenticated consent or protection against privileged rewriting of all evidence.

legacy.healthy_reads: PASS; exact historical Plan content NOT PROVEN

sqlite.migration: PASS: explicit offline library/CLI, no startup upgrade
sqlite.quiescence: Required operator attestation --owners-stopped; a write lock is not process/reader quiescence proof
sqlite.backup: PASS: WAL-aware SQLite consistent snapshot; new private file; validated before source DDL
sqlite.preservation: PASS: exact original three DDL/business-row sets equal immediately after migration, before subsequent new approval
sqlite.atomicity: PASS: before first addition, after partial DDL, legacy classification, before version update and before commit faults
sqlite.memory_ddl_reference: Ephemeral schema-object reference only; no business data or fallback store

bound_read_validation.run_read: PASS; invalid proof maps to existing DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE

tamper.valid_plan_A_to_B: PASS: semantic-valid note/goal replacement with unchanged terminal v5 and decision rows fails binding
tamper.arguments: PASS: exact text/Unicode retained; changed valid note denied
tamper.target: DENIED EARLIER: trusted schema/semantic target validation
tamper.step_order: PASS: reversed distinct notes remain semantic-valid but fail retained proof
tamper.step_count: PASS: added valid read changes full digest; no subset admission
tamper.binding: PASS: missing/null/copied/digest/status/revision/malformed/contradictory/time proof denied; duplicate constrained; orphan startup denied
tamper.run_and_approval: PASS: inconsistent decision/history linkage stays safe storage failure, before binding classification
tamper.action_spec_effect_event_receipt: PASS: tampered retained spec/effect key/event/receipt denies query/startup/replay
tamper.post_admission_replay: PASS: current proof/spec always revalidated; no trusted snapshot or rebind
tamper.client_overrides_and_inert_strings: PASS: strict bodies reject authority overrides; note remains data, not a path/URL/command

action.cas_foundations: Independent identity/version/source-state guards; no future lifecycle writer
action.cardinality: Run 0..N; UNIQUE(run_id, step_index), not UNIQUE(run_id); complete single-step MVP
action.specification_digest: Canonical action-spec-v1 SHA-256 includes all 14 pre-digest facts and derived approval revision/digest
action.effect_identity: Server UUIDv4 once at admission; independently validated against creation event; stable replay/reopen
action.get_list_purity: PASS: no new compilation, mutations, events, receipts, model/tool calls

compiler.approved_required: Approved/v5; linked APPROVE 4->5 with matching time/history
compiler.binding_required: BOUND_V1 retained contextual proof; legacy denied
compiler.trusted_registry: Explicit server-owned non-callable ToolBinding; empty default denies; stable configured scope UUID
compiler.normalization: Canonical JSON only; exact note Unicode/whitespace retained

admission.command: Internal ActionService/AdmissionCommand; strict expected_run_version body, server receipt subject, caller-stable UUIDv4 key
admission.idempotency: PASS: exact replay before CAS but current proof/spec checked; changed-body conflict
admission.different_key_same_step: Existing identical Action plus accepted new scoped receipt; no extra Action/event/version
admission.same_key_other_scope: Different subject/Run scopes are distinct; no semantic Intent deduplication
admission.concurrency: PASS: independent connections/barrier, same/different keys produce one Action/event
admission.receipt_atomicity: PASS: before/after Action/event/receipt insert and commit faults leave no partial facts
admission.uncertain_commit: PASS: safe error; explicit lookup/replay discovers single durable identity, no guessed success
admission.bounded_lock: PASS: 250 ms timeout, no partial admission
admission.toctou: PASS: checked Plan cannot change under admission write lock
